description: Replace the tools bound to an Agent. Read the current Agent first; this replaces its bindings.

config.description: Customer SETTINGS for this tool on this agent, keyed by the tool's config_schema field keys (e.g. { from_number, provider_api_key }). Fields marked secret are encrypted at rest and returned masked ('********'); re-send the mask (or omit) to keep the stored value.

execution.description: Resolved execution mode. Present on agent reads when the tool resolves.

input_schema.description: Per-call model argument schema. Present on agent reads when the tool resolves.

name.description: Present on agent reads when the tool resolves.

name: set_agent_tools
title: Set Agent Tools
